g.text: Sequential robot homing · lifetime, deadlines and cleanup
[Configured homing order, while no cancellation / fault / timeout]
Stack storage is reserved once per motor.
Thread control / TLS still need bounded runtime resources.
Creation failures are logged with motor and job identity.
Interrupting motion wait does not cancel motion.
A stop or timeout never resumes automatically.
Only completed homing stages establish references.
The same StepperMotor seek/release/re-latch path is used for individual axis homing.
Software behavior; disconnected-board fixtures use synthetic reference switches.
